[b]News regarding the THEP summit in Vëlvetel[/b]
The Alaqan Khanate had watched the events unfolding in the White Sea quietly but with much focus due to its influence on Tel Karmiw, an island next to Alaqar that it had interests in. When the Flousech government invited the members of the Thýven-Hydronia Economic Pact to a diplomatic summit, Alaqar was eager to discuss future plans with its fellow members and sent an ambassador to Vëlvetel. This ambassador, Şamid Vahidli, was to arrive at Flousechia by means of air travel with an Alaqan government plane.

As for military matters, an exercise force consisting of air, naval and ground forces and personnel was sent to Flousechia to participate in the THEP summit. The following forces were sent to Flousechia:

[b]NAVY[/b]
1 Bürchmulla Class diesel-electric submarine
2 Ghijand Class frigates 
1 Rejder Class corvette
1800 personnel

[b]AIR FORCE[/b]
4 SF-95 fighter jets
300 personnel

[b]GROUND FORCES[/b]
6000 personnel

General Hansëli was placed in charge of the operation, of which he assigned both his most trusted and most experienced in command of smaller pieces of the exercise force. General Hansëli was flown in the same plane as the ambassador, and is planned to exit in the same plane as he came in.

[b]Business of Early 2027 | Erene 2000 | Second Flouesch Republic[/b]

[Spoiler=post][b][sub]NVMKS "Mila Weber" launched, finally.[/sub][/b]

It was a clear, but cold day in the city of Komend, the Republic's largest city and home to the Komend Naval Yards, surprising for the usual winter weather residents were used to. And also a day of celebration in the city, a crowd of thirty thousand or so people had gathered to watch the launch of the NVKMS Mila Weber. Having begun construction in April 2018 under the royalist government, the unfinished carrier's construction was interrupted by the beginning of the Floueschian Revolution, and then, when construction was finally set to resume in October 2025, the new Republican Government paused construction for another several months as a full inspection on the empty hull had to be conducted after a worker died from a fall. Construction would finally resume in January 2026 and continue through the year. Although with a redesign plan, initially it was supposed to be a standard helicopter carrier; however, with the increasing usage of drones in naval warfare the Admiralty and a new direction for the Floueschian navy in general, the carrier was instead to not only be able to hold ASW Helicopters and VTOL aircraft, but also act as a drone mothership, carrying on top of its complement of 26 helicopters or 16 Republic Hurricanes around 100 VAKO Fixed Wing Loitering Munition drones, this added additional time to the ship's construction process as space had to be designed for this complement and a designated drone command center created.

Another point of contention was around the ship's name. Three proposed names were reportedly debated by the admiralty that being the NVMKS Tricolor, NVMKS Mila Weber, or NVMKS Sovereignty. The last name being favored by the Secretariat of Defense is Gonthier Fuelenger. However, in the end, the First Consul announced that the ship would be named the Mila Weber, in honor of Mila Weber, the youngest victim of the Republic Plaza Massacre. The ship would be christened during its launching ceremony by the mother of Mila Weber, Olivia Weber. In attendance also was Secretariat of Defense Gonthier Fuelenger, President of the Staatsrot Julie Krier. After a bottle of Nevonian Champagne was broken across her bow, she was slipped into the White Sea. The ship is already complete, as the Admiralty decided to forgo any further delays, and after a short stay in Komend's dock for public touring of non-critical facilities, she will begin her sea trials in early February. She is now the pride of the Floueschian navy and a symbol for its future.

[b]It only took nine years.[/b]

[b][sub]Admiralty releases new naval rearmament program[/sub][/b]

Today, January 5th, 2027, the admiralty in conjunction with the launch of the NVKMS "Mila Weber" has announced its new Naval Rearmament Plan using the funds delegated to the National Peoples Army Naval Forces by the Republic Defender 2036 Act. The Admiralty had been for the better part of the year, looking at conflicts across the globe and then the state of the Republic's new allies in THEP and deciding what role the Floueschian navy would come to play in coming conflicts. On their mind, especially was the White Sea crisis. During the White Sea crisis, the Navies of the EDU were largely allowed to turn the White Sea into their playground, making it an impossibility that Floueschia would be able to adequately supply the Tallislandic anti-principalists, and some, especially in the Radical Republican Party, call this a massive defeat. Their new naval strategy, one that does not require them to control the White Sea like the Royalist Navy attempted to do. However, deny the use of the White Sea to the adversary.

The core doctrine of the new strategy outlines 5 key points:

1. Everything must be inexpensive enough to lose in potentially large numbers
2. Everything must be able to kill something potentially 5x to 10x its own cost
3. Everything must be fast enough to run away after attacking
4. Through harassment, sea denial, and hit and run tactics, inflict maximum attrition upon an enemy navy
5. Ideally, never be detected before you fire, never fight fair, never fire from the same place twice, and never give enemy navies time to localize and retaliate
Rely on stealth, intelligence gathering, waves of high-speed missiles and cheap drones, torpedoes, mines, and ambushes.

To meet the requirements of this new strategy for the Navy. An almost 22 billion dollar deal has been made between the Admiralty with major arms manufacturers VAKO, VVM, and AWG. Along with the shipbuilding company that runs the Komend Naval Yards, Ardennen Marine Shipbuilding Federation, freshly reformed from its royalist origins into a Workers Cooperative. The deal involves the creation of 3 new classes of ships for the navy, which will be, firstly, the new Tricolor Class Corvettes. These corvettes are stealth missile corvettes, meant for ambushes. At over 1,500 tons, they are capable of carrying a shocking 76 missiles, along with an advanced 76 mm deck cannon, and 4 VAKO 35mm CIWS Guns. The next being its slightly heavier, non-stealth cousin, the Reason Class Corvettes, coming in at 2,100 tons. It can carry even more missiles, around 88 in total. It also has a 76 mm deck gun and 4 VAKO Remote Guns. Lastly, the Lambert Class Fast Attack Craft is much lighter, around 295 tons, and can carry around 16 missiles. The deal will last until 2032, and it involves the procurement of the following items:

Fraternité-II class submarines: 12
Tricolor class corvettes: 20
Reason class corvettes: 60
Lambert-class fast attack craft: 40
Submarine tenders: 6
Fast replenishment ships: 4
ELINT/ISR ships: 5

At least the admiralty will be able to do something

[b][sub]Schools reopen for the 2027-2028 School Year[/sub][/b]

The Department of the Interior, which controls the Floueschian Educational Administration Authority, has announced that, finally, after almost 3 years of being closed, public schools finally reopen for the 2027-2028 School Year on February 1st, 2027. The shutdown began under the kingdom in January 2024 when the Ministry of Education announced that, due to the ongoing revolution and complete lack of teaching staff, the operation of public schools had become untenable and they would be shut down until further notice. Further notice never came. And as the Republic replaced the kingdom's institutions, the Department of Interior announced that, because the nation's infrastructure had been so damaged by the war, practically all public schools would require renovations and repairs after being, at best, left dilapidated and unmaintained, which was not good for buildings largely built in the 80s and 90s, and at worst destroyed. And that they had to find new administrators as many were now imprisoned, fired, or worse, and that they had to rewrite Floueschia's curriculum that schools would remain closed, for another year at most. Many school buildings across the country have just been outright rebuilt.

The new Floueschian curriculum was designed by a mix of Floueschian officials and international advisors, putting a focus on STEM, Vocational Skills, Civic Education, and community engagement. Although a republican version of history has been definitely forced into the new curriculum to further demonize the Kingdom in the eyes of the youth. Schools will now operate more democratically, starting in Secondary School, all schools will have elected student councils that will work and negotiate with school administrators on policy decisions moving forward. The National Board of Education will also have a student member.

[b]Welcome back to...school.[/b]

[b][sub]Diamond Tower begins construction[/sub][/b]

Ground was broken today at the future site of Diamond Tower, a planned massive 1,903-foot tower in the heart of the nation's capital of Vëlvetel. The project is one of the largest projects conducted by the Republic to date. VAKO has taken the lead as the primary designer and builder of the tower; however, the project has come to involve thousands of other construction firms, almost 80 factories and steel mills, foreign workers from Dashinka, the National Public Works Authority, the Republic Labour Service, and most surprisingly the National Peoples Army Engineering Corps and the Internal Revolutionary Guard Construction Corps. The plan was first proposed by the local council to the Revolutionary Council of State in early December 2025, meant to replace the Vëlvetel Fortress, a massive fortress that took up the center of the city, a fortress that had been demolished after the revolution and now left an awkward, gated hole in the center of the city. Something the local council wanted to correct as quickly as humanly possible. The proposal's design was by André Flammang, who had also designed the Palace of the Republic.

The base of the tower would be around 34,000 m², before going up like an hourglass, with it slimming in the center before expanding again, and then the top would brilliant crown-like shape, topped by a 90 m needle spire. Surrounding it and taking up the rest of the space would be a park with spaces for a market or a mall, underground would be 2 sections, one connecting the tower to the subway, and an underground parking garage. It would have an observation deck and would primarily be office space, something the city desperately needed. The tower's construction timetable was even more insane. The city wanted it built in a little over 12 months, well, sort of pre Pre-fabrication would begin immediately while the site was prepared. Then, using a combination of 24/7 work crews, imported mega cranes, the tower would basically be put together like Lego, and after it had been, everything from plumbing, wiring, and furniture would be put in. The proposal was rejected, with fears of spiraling costs and an already 2 billion dollar price tag attached to it. However, for some reason, in early May of 2026, the Revolutionary Council of State approved the proposal, which promised to cover 50% of the budget, and even ordered the military to begin assisting in the construction. Declaring it a national effort and a potential symbol of national pride.

This was because, unbeknownst to anyone involved in the project but the mayor of Vëlvetel, Aly Wolff, Muller, Fuelenger, and Reuter, the tower was to become, secretly, the host to a military installation. In early 2025, retreating royalists completely destroyed the National Military Communication Center outside of Nyralis. It had been built in the mid-70s to be a massive communication array that could basically communicate and coordinate military forces anywhere across Nevonia and the Republic. And now that it was gone, the National Peoples Army could no longer effectively operate within their own country; whatever was left of the Republic's communication infrastructure was overstressed. The NPA had become extremely concerned that this could severely compromise the defense of the country. However, this project presented an interesting opportunity. The size of the tower allowed Troposcatter range to jump from 200km to around 480km, radar horizon would jump to 90km, and the Tactical UHF/VHF mesh could reach 120130 km. And the crown of the tower was conveniently large enough to hide all of this equipment in, the underground plans could allow for a military bunker directly underneath the tower.

Therefore, a deal was made between the city and the Stase, the military would take over direct construction of the underground and crown, and would be allowed to put whatever they wanted inside of there, and in return for not saying anything about this, the mayor would get his funding, and an additional 800 million dollars that he requested earlier to continue his public housing programs with the Stase using their contacts within the Revolutionary Council of State to lobby the vote into just barely passing. The design of the crown was now in their hands. Attached to the needle of the crown would be 12 × High-Power Digital Troposcatter Panels, giving a range of around 720,000  850,000 km², all of them hidden by the fibreglass radome. Inside the crown itself would be two specially designed 6.5 m S-band AESA panels, one facing north, and one facing south, lying flat and vertical, covered by the structural glass, and then a layer of 50 mm ir masking. And then finally, 8 1.8 m flat-panel satcom dishes, 4 attached to the north, upward-facing side of the crown, and 4 attached to the south, upward facing side of the crown, the roof glass of the crown secretly replaced, with 12 mm thick RF transparent ceramic composite, and a service corridor that would allow military maintenance personnel to access all of this without anyone noticing.

 A cover story was conveniently created as well, added to the plans, suddenly a 6g research lab, and a national radio service that would be hosted from the tower, playing emergency alerts, news bulletins from the government, and music sent in by citizens, to explain all of the activity coming from the top of the tower to both citizens and other nations. And only adding around 1.4 billion to the initial budget

A layered offensive strategy was instated, once a active SAM was detected by a AWAC or reconaissance drone, the coordinates and wavelength band of the system was uplinked to a local EA-18G, which focused on jamming and disrupting these systems before they could direct an attack. While the distraction ensued, F-15's were dispatched to the flash zone to operate a direct delivery drop off of JDAMs onto the targets. These were intended to strike with surgical precision, and leave Valdderan air defences constantly on the run.

In the vast expanses of the Northern sea, Valddera owned two major islands that proved strategically priceless if Daesun wanted to proliferate its influence in the artic. And so they were also listed onto the chopping block, Daesun dispatched its North Sea Strike Force 1, also known as NSTF-1 to the islands, accompanied by marines who travelled on LCU's and other watercraft. NSTF-1 consisted of 1 Virginia-class submarine, 3 Independence-class LCS, 2 Arleigh Burke-class destroyers, and 1 Antonio-class LPD, which acted as the command ship of the task force. Daesun had only one strategy in mind, striking as quickly as possible before local Valdderan military could reciprocate. Leading the pack of the task force was the single Virginia class submarine, staying submerged under the vast abyss, it stayed over 14 hours  ahead of its comrades. She was tasked with carrying out a lightning strike to disorient local Valdderan forces, while also making way for her partners. Analyzing the islands, the Virginia-class would search for Valdderan coastal artillery, SAM positions, minefields, communication nodes, and enemy radar signatures. Collected intel was put up on a broad information sharing band, allowing for the rest of the task force to listen in on what the Virginia class had found out. But information wasn't the only thing she seeked, her first objective still wasn't completed. Once the her armaments were within range of the Valdderan islands, the attack submarine would launch a fury of Tomohawk missiles, each streaking towards sophisticated high value targets such as coastal radars, C2 bunkers, and long range SAM sites. In total, a volley of 8 tomahawks screamed towards Valddera, each getting closer and closer as seconds passed by, the Valdderans only had so much time to effectively respond. Immediately after her assault, the Virginia class would resubmerge into low depth to wait for the rest of NSTF-1 to catch up, re-initiating its stealth to avoid detecting. Her attack was only the beginning, and paled in comparison to what awaited Valddera. 

But there was also another target that caught Daesun's eye, a pair of islands in the middle of the Shamite sea, two that were crucial in proliferating Daesun's influence in the sea. Just south of the islands roared the Mugunghwa shield, a heavy naval task force that had just completed its service in Astanir, contributing to Nordiheim's defeat in the Argossia. Their attention now veered north, towards Valddera's claims. But there was one major problem, the shield had to carefully thread itself through THEP territory, as a major alliance competing with Daesun for influence in the Shamite sea, caution was a priority. Mugunghwa's route traversed through [nation]Blobon[/nation]ite and [nation]BR Bob[/nation]ian waters, carefully avoiding any confrontation with THEP. A warning was also dispatched to [nation]United Hydronia[/nation]ns residing within the archipelago near Valddera's claims of the shield's action in Valddera.

Recon drones such as the RQ-4 and Orlan-10 drones were dispatched to the island to analyze data and then send it back to Mugunghwa for dissection. The operation had to be precise, as Daesun could not afford losing a global hawk to Valdderan air defences. While the Orlan-10s were inexpensive and numerous, allowing for Daesun to dispatch many. 

Back in the mainland, the long idle of the 103rd infantry regiment finally ceased. Once Daesun  achieved full aerial superiority and began an operation eliminating remaining air defences, the airborne assault force could now operate on reduced caution. To avoid direct confrontation with the Valdderan army, the regiment focused on achieving a massive airlift straight to the capital, where they could then seize control of the country and de-esculate the situation. A mix of heavy CH-47's and A-64's were manned to lead the assault, with the Apaches acting as a spearhead, focusing on direct attacks on potential ground threats. While the Chinooks were the soft underbelly, containing most of the regiment, they were the heavy transport of the regiment and therefore needed sufficient defence to ensure safety. 

With contest in Valdderan airspace completely obliterated, heavy bombing campaigns could also be placed into action. B-52s deployed from Persephone were dispatched to operational bombing campaigns deep within Valdderan territory. Still paranoid about Valddera's SAM capabilities, the bombers focused on standoff range bombing.
